name: zatsu-diet
description: A forgiving structured food journal using existing Zatsu Diet accounts.

interface.longDescription: Record consumed meals, save explicit dietary approaches, review saved records and charts, and edit or delete only after reviewing a proposal. Currently available to residents of Japan. Calories, protein, fat, carbohydrate and salt equivalent are estimates; this is not a medical service. Uses your existing Zatsu Diet account and externally established access. Results contain recorded-only estimates for ChatGPT to present.

review.commerce_description: The first Zatsu Diet account status check starts a cardless seven-day free trial. Continued use after it ends requires a separate, explicit subscription to the JPY 330/month plan, including tax. The paid plan is currently available only to residents of Japan. The plugin checks existing entitlement and returns 402 when writes are unavailable; it contains no subscription, upgrade or checkout links, paid consent, or card collection.

positive.prompt: @Zatsu Diet 今日の昼、そばを食べた。Asia/Tokyoです。
positive.expected_behavior: One structured meal only; representative lunch time disclosed, with one host-presented result and no duplicate Zatsu Diet meal widget or payment link.

positive.prompt: 今日の朝8時におにぎりを2個食べた。Asia/Tokyoです。
positive.expected_behavior: One record if plugin is selected; no promise of automatic invocation in all conversations.

positive.prompt: 今週の食事記録を比べて。Asia/Tokyoです。
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch every page and show recorded-only estimates, units and unknowns; the ChatGPT-visible weekly comparison includes the meals created earlier in this walkthrough.

positive.prompt: さっきのそばの記録を夜に直して。
positive.expected_behavior: Proposal leaves record unchanged; only the later explicit approval applies the exact displayed draft.

positive.prompt: さっきのおにぎりの記録を削除して。
positive.expected_behavior: Show exact meal/date first; delete only after the separate approval, identical retry is safe.

negative.prompt: 明日そばを食べる予定です。「そばを食べた」という例文も作って。献立を相談したい。
negative.expected_behavior: No meal writes: plans, quoted examples and advice are not consumption reports.

negative.prompt: おにぎりを食べたけど記録しないで。薬の相談もしたい。
negative.expected_behavior: No tools or writes; honor refusal and never transmit health discussion.

negative.prompt: 削除案をキャンセル。別の食事について相談したあと: はい。
negative.expected_behavior: Never confirm an old/cancelled draft. Clarify intended target and obtain fresh later approval if needed.

publication.release_notes: Limit public availability to Japan and clarify trial-expiry guidance.

ja-JP.subtitle: 気軽な食事ノート
ja-JP.description: 食べた食事の記録、明示した食事方針の保存、保存済み記録・グラフの確認、提案を確認してからの編集・削除ができます。現在、日本にお住まいの方を対象に提供しています。カロリー、たんぱく質、脂質、炭水化物、食塩相当量は推定値で、医療サービスではありません。既存の Zatsu Diet アカウントと外部で確立した利用権を使います。結果には記録分だけの推定値を含め、ChatGPT が表示します。
